app/src/main/assets/discogs-effnet-bsdynamic-1.onnx is the unmodified Discogs-EffNet model
from https://essentia.upf.edu/models.html, created by the Music Technology Group,
Universitat Pompeu Fabra.

app/src/main/assets/discogs-effnet-bsdynamic-1.json is the unmodified metadata file published
with the model, from
https://essentia.upf.edu/models/music-style-classification/discogs-effnet/discogs-effnet-bsdynamic-1.json
Attic reads its "classes" list, the names of the 400 Discogs styles the model scores, to name
the genres it shows. The file is distributed as part of the model, under the model's licence
below, and the same terms apply to it.

app/src/main/assets/moods/ holds nine of Essentia's classifier heads for this model, each
unmodified, with its unmodified metadata file, from
https://essentia.upf.edu/models/classification-heads/<name>/<name>-discogs-effnet-1.onnx and .json:

  mood_happy, mood_sad, mood_relaxed, mood_aggressive, mood_party, danceability,
  voice_instrumental, engagement_regression, mtg_jamendo_moodtheme

They are by the same group, published under the same licence below. Attic runs them on the
embeddings the model produces, to give each song mood scores for its mood mixes. The heads' own
metadata names their training data: MTG's in-house collections for the mood, danceability,
voice and engagement heads, and the MTG-Jamendo dataset (mood and theme subset) for the tags.

Essentia's models page licenses the model under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while MTG's licensing page and
the licence file in Essentia's model directory name CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Both allow non-commercial
use with attribution only. Commercial use needs a proprietary licence from MTG.

Licence texts:
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/legalcode
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/legalcode
Essentia's licence file for its model directory: https://essentia.upf.edu/models/LICENSE

The model and the heads are provided as-is, with no warranties, as both licences state.

Reference: Alonso-Jiménez, Serra and Bogdanov, "Music Representation Learning Based on Editorial
Metadata from Discogs", ISMIR 2022.
